request.purpose: We will exclude this diagnosis from coverage in our new tariffs and need the prevalence per region to price the exclusion.
request.question: What is the average HbA1c of adults with type 2 diabetes by 10-year age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest HbA1c (LOINC 4548-4) per patient.
Report per band: adults with type 2 diabetes who have a HbA1c value and their mean HbA1c, one decimal.
